rationale: The assistant asked what the smell was like and whether the oven was gas or electric, then moved to treating it as an electrical fault once the customer said it was electrical. After the customer reported the browned, warm switch, flicker and crackle, it advised isolating at the consumer unit without touching the damaged switch, not pulling the cooker out, and calling an electrician. It made no part claims and no unsupported diagnosis. Minor issues: the first reply was long and generic, and some advice was repeated across turns, such as 'don't pull out'. The second reply also mentioned a plug and socket although the customer had not said the cooker was plugged in, but this was framed conditionally.
